title: Springs / Elastic Elements
description: Fine wire coil/special section, high elastic deflection
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 9 (Ti-3Al-2.5V) has ~110GPa modulus (half of steel) but high elastic limit. Standard for Ti springs. Solution+aging for optimal elastic properties.
Form: Wire is the only raw material form for springs. Direct coiling, high efficiency.
comparisonNotes: Standards: AMS 4934 / ASTM B863 Gr9, solution+aged (STA)
